name: RK Beach
blurb: A popular urban beach known for its scenic views and lively evening promenade.

name: Submarine Museum
blurb: Housed inside a real decommissioned submarine, showcasing naval history on the shores of RK Beach.

name: Yarada Beach
blurb: A secluded and serene beach enclosed by lush green hills on three sides.

name: Kailasagiri
blurb: A hilltop park offering panoramic views of the city and the Bay of Bengal.

name: Simhachalam Temple
blurb: An ancient hilltop shrine dedicated to Lord Narasimha, renowned for its stunning Kalinga architecture.

name: Rushikonda Beach
blurb: A pristine gold-sand beach famous for water sports and golden sunrises.

name: Bojjannakonda
blurb: A fascinating cluster of ancient rock-cut Buddhist caves and monolithic stupas dating back to the 4th century.

name: Borra Caves
blurb: Million-year-old limestone caves featuring spectacular stalactite and stalagmite formations.

name: Araku Valley
blurb: A picturesque hill station known for its sprawling coffee plantations, waterfalls, and pleasant weather.

name: Lambasingi
blurb: Often called the Kashmir of Andhra Pradesh, famous for its misty mornings and chilly temperatures.
